data.one_liner: Initialize modules and test module integration in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Modular_test helps initialize modules for testing integration within Flutter projects. It allows starting single or multiple modules and replacing binds during tests.
use_when: You are writing integration tests for modular projects
You need to initialize modules within test setups
You need to mock or replace specific binds in a module during testing
avoid_when: You are not using modular architecture
You only need standard unit testing without module management
strengths: Allows replacing binds like mocks easily
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples beyond basic usage
Tied to specific modular architecture patterns
data.setup_notes: Add modular_test to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard core testing framework for Dart without modular constraints.
